home.purpose: Home feed: a grid of video tiles and Shorts tiles.
home.ready_when: video tiles are rendered (YouTube is a single-page app: tiles stream in after navigation).

channel.purpose: A channel page (example @RayCodingCorner): the same tile types as Home.

watch.purpose: Watch page (example watch?v=xxf6D9jynFw): the main player plus video tiles in the right sidebar.

playlist.purpose: A playlist page (?list=ID). Shows the real contents immediately after a change - the independent check for saves.

navigation: All pages are one single-page app: listen for yt-navigate-finish instead of page loads; tile elements are reused with new data.
Video identity = the 11-character ID in the tile's link (watch?v=ID or /shorts/ID), never the tile's position.
